reviews.reason: The existing press trial measures load response, not surface hardness. Neither observation nor the tool-dependent interfaces provide an equivalent hardness test. Develop a conservative scratch-comparison assessment: actual tests can establish relative surface resistance now, while an absolute hardness ≥8 conclusion remains unresolved unless physically validated reference evidence supports it. Your remaining stone is a testable specimen, not an already certified tool.
reviews.experienceReview: A successful experiment can provide grounded understanding even when it resolves only relative resistance rather than tool suitability. On hardness-comparison-completed, emit information-confirmed with qualified=true only for the performing living actor when paid physical work establishes a previously unverified, interpretable observation with retained evidence. Use the existing grounded-understanding source, not a new alias: transient amount 0.8, cap 1, duration 8 rounds, refresh repetition and 12-round cooldown; sustained gain 0.035 per qualifying event under the existing maintenance cadence, decay 0.0015 and existing source saturation. Repeated known results, ambiguous trials, assessment of unchanged records, requesting and learning award nothing. Continued actual informative testing may maintain satisfaction; mastery alone may not. No nutrition, health, survival or physical-comfort benefit is inferred.
reviews.visualReview: Show the actual held specimens, directional contact stroke, surface marks or debris, and a paid-stage progress indicator. Replay binds to the declared test events and retains specimen identities, actual damage, costs and uncertainty. No certification glow, completed apparatus or other unpaid physical effect appears.
reviews.specification:
Implement hardness-assessment@1, reusing owned-item resolution, paid-stage execution and evidence storage as code dependencies, not as equivalent functions. Public strict schema: {mode:'inspect'|'compare'|'assess',target:string,reference:string,project:string}; all fields required, reference empty except compare. Shared references: target/reference resolve actual owned item IDs once; project is an actor-owned persistent ID. Require personal mastery before use; no other mastery prerequisite. No stock, standards, apparatus or mastery is supplied.
State: store specimen identity, source batch, tested surface, alteration history, reference identity and certification lineage if any, stage, energy paid, exact allocated quantities, remaining work, directional scratch observations, uncertainty and conclusion. Keep findings specimen-specific; do not certify a whole resource category or transfer a tested chip's result to an unrelated stone.
Executable precursor: inspect takes one round and 0.2 energy, recording accessible edges, surface condition and whether a controlled comparison is possible. Compare requires two distinct actual owned specimens with usable contact geometry; reserve 0.1 unit from each in project-owned escrow. It performs two directional scratch strokes in two rounds, each costing 0.5 energy. Implement a versioned physical contact law using actual surface resistance, edge radius, applied force and wear: distinguish persistent grooves from transferred powder, inspect both surfaces, and report comparative resistance or an inconclusive result when geometry, fracture or contamination prevents interpretation. Store the measured contact conditions and uncertainty. This is not the existing load/flexibility law. Preserve the two tested portions as altered specimens and conserve their mass, including any detached debris; do not destroy a full sample merely to charge for testing. Reject unavailable quantities before allocation, without charges.
Assess takes one round and 0.2 energy and evaluates the project's actual evidence. Define and publish the hardness scale used by the existing >=8 tool predicate; do not silently equate it to Mohs hardness. Absolute bounds require independently traceable physical reference measurements on that same scale, with uncertainty. Resource names, catalogue labels, an interface's own threshold, circular certifications and held-load observations are not reference measurements. With no suitable reference, return 'absolute hardness unresolved' plus any supported relative result. Certify >=8 only when a conservative supported lower bound reaches 8. Failed or ambiguous scratching must not imply softness. No calibrated reference is currently established by the supplied evidence; none is created by this implementation.
Geometry and lifecycle: work occurs at the actor's actual position with held specimens, requires usable contact geometry and creates no room or collision footprint. Missing energy or contact access pauses without charges. Completion records only executed work. Global pauses preserve exact progress. Action change, loss of possession or death cancels once, releasing surviving escrow to its living owner or, on death, to ground at the actual position; consumed work is never refunded. Partial observations persist. Explicitly repeating compare starts a new paid test, never duplicates prior outputs.
Register hardness-inspected, hardness-test-progress, hardness-comparison-completed, hardness-assessment-completed and hardness-test-stopped. Include project, participant, resolved item IDs, paid costs, contact geometry, alteration, observations, bounds and remaining work in event payloads. Extend information-confirmed subscription validation for this interface. Migrate old records non-destructively: existing press findings remain load evidence, all previously unmeasured hardness stays unknown, and existing tool requirements remain unchanged. A supported assessment may become evidence for their eligibility resolver without granting hardness or weakening prerequisites.

request.name: Physical tool-hardness assessment
request.function: Measure whether an actual owned stone meets the hardness >=8 prerequisite used by bark stripping and assay fabrication, using a physically grounded test rather than inferring hardness from its resource name or load resistance.
request.conditions: I own 0.9 stone in item-61-moss-327. A gentle press at load 0.2 held with flexibility 0, but did not measure hardness. Existing tool-dependent interfaces require hardness >=8.
request.inputs: The owned stone is available. Required comparison materials or equipment are unknown; do not assume they exist.
request.costs: Unknown. Specify finite material use, effort, risks and any prerequisite standards or apparatus.
request.effects: Retain an actual measured result with uncertainty and provenance, or an explicit unresolved result if available materials cannot support the measurement. Do not grant hardness, create standards, or certify suitability without evidence.

evidence: Tick 67: a stone pressing trial at load 0.2 held, with measured flexibility 0.

completedSteps: Opened and completed internal examination of an owned root sample.
projects.next: Use the measured condition without treating it as a chemical safety test.
projects.benefit: Established internal physical condition without ingestion.
